summary: BI-9BAAD504 repairs duplicate permission authority without schema changes. Existing Agent execution aliases and FK references remain. Matching grants and non-widening revocations retire only after bounded per-key original provenance is written into the existing ToolExecution authority audit ledger. Conflicts and missing canonical owners remain unchanged. Revocation-only rows move intact to the canonical owner; no grants are unioned. Reruns are no-ops. Boot seeding no longer recreates alias permissions. Administrator conflict approval uses a state-bound serializable transaction, preserving original selected actor/time and approval identity in the audit. Rollback is a code revert plus reviewed recovery from audit, never automatic re-granting. Existing model confidentiality and retention declarations remain unchanged; ToolExecution provenance follows its governed authority-audit retention floors.
